input:
/data/access.log has lines `<timestamp> user=<name> path=<path> status=<3 digits>` in no particular order. A valid timestamp is ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` followed by `Z` or a `+HH:MM`/`-HH:MM` offset; a line with any other timestamp (no offset, a space instead of T, an impossible time) or not matching the format exactly is skipped. Duplicate lines are separate events.

Split each user's events, ordered by instant, into sessions: a new session starts when the gap to the previous event is more than 30 minutes (a gap of exactly 30:00 stays in the same session).

Write /out/sessions.tsv (tab-separated) with header user, session, start, end, events, seconds: one row per session, sorted by user then start; session numbers start at 1 per user; start/end are UTC as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; seconds = end minus start.
Write /out/summary.txt with the single line `users=U sessions=S events=E skipped=K`.

import re,datetime as D
from collections import defaultdict
pat=re.compile(r'(\d{4})-(\d\d)-(\d\d)T(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d)(Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d) user=(\S+) path=(\S+) status=(\d{3})')
ev=defaultdict(list);sk=0;n=0
for l in open('/data/access.log',encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n'):
    if l.endswith('\r'): l=l[:-1]
    if l=='' : continue
    m=pat.fullmatch(l)
    if not m: sk+=1;continue
    try:
        tz=m[7]
        if tz!='Z':
            if int(tz[1:3])>23 or int(tz[4:])>59: raise ValueError
        d=D.datetime.fromisoformat(l.split(' ')[0])
        if d.tzinfo is None: raise ValueError
    except ValueError: sk+=1;continue
    ev[m[8]].append(d.astimezone(D.timezone.utc));n+=1
f=lambda d:d.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
rows=[];S=0
for u in sorted(ev):
    t=sorted(ev[u]);ss=[[t[0],t[0],1]]
    for x in t[1:]:
        if (x-ss[-1][1]).total_seconds()>1800: ss.append([x,x,1])
        else: ss[-1][1]=x;ss[-1][2]+=1
    for i,s in enumerate(ss,1):
        rows.append(f"{u}\t{i}\t{f(s[0])}\t{f(s[1])}\t{s[2]}\t{int((s[1]-s[0]).total_seconds())}")
open('/out/sessions.tsv','w').write("user\tsession\tstart\tend\tevents\tseconds\n"+"\n".join(rows)+"\n")
open('/out/summary.txt','w').write(f"users={len(ev)} sessions={len(rows)} events={n} skipped={sk}\n")
E
python3 /tmp/s.py; cat /out/*
